title: Senior Software Engineer - Frontend
jobDescription: As a part of the Sense team, you’ll play an active role in shaping and developing our products and processes. Our founders are lifelong entrepreneurs with a history of building, scaling, and successfully exiting large companies. At Sense, your career goals will be supported through active mentorship and learning and development opportunities. We’re an experienced team and looking for great people to add to our team.We care deeply about the success of our customers and strive to help them achieve their goals in inspiring and engaging with their workforce. Sense is seeking a Senior or Lead Frontend Engineer to deliver our contractor communication platform to the world’s best places to work. As a Frontend Engineer at Sense, you’ll be intimately involved with bringing features from idea to completion, and mentoring an incredibly talented group of peers. You’ll join a collaborative, fun team where everyone, including you, is active in the product defining and development process. Our founders are lifelong entrepreneurs and have built and scaled large companies. By working with them, you will have the front row seat to see how a company grows and scales. We want to support your career goals, whether it remains here or beyond. Interested in knowing how product management or sales work? Let’s have you sit in on actual sales calls. Wondering how to grow engineering teams in a high growth company? We’ll directly mentor you and you’ll learn from those who’ve been at multiple successful companies. Sense is a rapidly scaling company making this the best environment to take on ownership as well as learning how to grow a company. Responsibilities Contribute to the ongoing development and upkeep of our design system Provide product ownership and mentor a team of talented Frontend Engineers Build and maintain crisp, consistent interfaces for our customers Lead code reviews, pairing sessions, and architecture discussions Responsibility for several large-scale React JS web applications Work closely with our cross-functional teams consisting of designers, product managers, and QA in an agile, fast-paced environment Implement and maintain features such as Chat interfaces and data visualisations Participate in code reviews and architecture discussions Participate in interviews and hiring as we staff up our team

title: DevOps Engineer
jobDescription: As part of the SRE team you will be owning and managing the infrastructure (Compute, Data Stores, Cloud Services, etc) that power Sense Application and Services. Devise solutions that address performance, scale and architectural issues, that arise as the Business and Engineering complexity grows. Heavy focus on automating all aspects of Cloud Operations, such as Infrastructure (Infra As Code), Configuration Management, Monitoring & Alerting, Performance Insights, Infra Costs, and so on. Ensure monitoring coverage of all Production services, and be part of On call rotation to monitor and address critical issues, with a focus on actions that result in long-term remediation.

title: Product Manager
jobDescription:
As a Product Manager – AI Automation & Engagement Platform , you will play a critical role in shaping the future of Sense’s intelligent automation and agentic AI ecosystem. You will work on some of Sense’s most strategic platform capabilities, including: Intelligent Workflow Automation Orchestration & Automation Engine AI-powered recruiter productivity experiences Agentic assistants and copilots through Sense IQ Cross-platform engagement automation and execution systems This role sits at the intersection of AI, workflow orchestration, automation infrastructure, and recruiter productivity. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Design, AI/ML teams, Customer Success, and GTM teams to conceptualize, build, and scale products that automate recruiting workflows and empower recruiters with AI-driven assistance. This is an excellent opportunity for a high-potential Product Manager who enjoys solving complex platform and systems problems, thrives in ambiguity, and wants to grow into a larger product leadership role over time. Role and Responsibilities Product Strategy & Vision Work closely with Product Leadership to define and evolve the vision for Sense’s AI Automation and Engagement Platform. Contribute to the roadmap for: Workflow automation capabilities Orchestration and execution engines AI-powered recruiter experiences Agentic assistants and copilots Cross-channel engagement automation Identify opportunities where AI and automation can meaningfully improve recruiter productivity, operational efficiency, and candidate experience. Stay current with advancements in Agentic AI, LLM ecosystems, workflow orchestration, and enterprise automation trends. Product Execution & Delivery Own end-to-end product execution for key platform capabilities and features. Translate ambiguous business and customer problems into clear product requirements, workflows, PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Collaborate closely with Engineering and Design teams as part of the EPD (Engineering–Product–Design) triad. Drive feature prioritization, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release coordination. Work closely with QA teams to ensure product quality and comprehensive test coverage. Perform User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and ensure delivered features meet customer and usability expectations. AI & Automation Platform Development Partner with AI/ML and Engineering teams to build scalable AI-driven workflows and automation systems. Contribute to the design of intelligent orchestration capabilities across recruiting workflows and user journeys. Help define interaction patterns and experiences for AI assistants, copilots, and agentic systems within Sense IQ. Collaborate on platform capabilities involving: Workflow engines Event-driven systems Integrations and APIs Automation triggers and actions AI-generated recommendations and actions Balance customer flexibility with platform scalability, reliability, and maintainability. Customer & Stakeholder Collaboration Work closely with enterprise customers, recruiters, implementation teams, and customer-facing stakeholders to deeply understand pain points and workflow inefficiencies. Conduct customer discovery sessions, product demos, and roadmap discussions. Collaborate with Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, and Product Marketing teams for successful feature adoption and enablement. Gather product feedback and usage insights to continuously improve platform experiences. Metrics & Product Insights Define and monitor key product and platform metrics such as: Workflow adoption and automation rates User engagement and productivity improvements AI feature usage and effectiveness Platform reliability and execution success rates Customer satisfaction and adoption Partner with Product Analytics and Data teams to derive actionable insights and identify optimization opportunities. Professional Qualifications BE/B.Tech or M.B.A with at least 4
- 7 years of experience in the product management role Proficient in English, with good written and oral communication and presentation skills Excellent academics throughout Good System Design and Analytical skills to able to take a problem statement and conceptualize solutions for the same Good knowledge of the software development life cycle Ability to prioritize and balance multiple tasks Strong organizational skills Able to work harmoniously within a team environment Ability to process and apply feedback constructively Ability to “do what it takes to get the job done”

title: Brand & Motion Designer
jobDescription: Are you a storyteller who thinks in motion and breathes visual design? We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented Motion & Visual Designer to join the Sense Creative team. In this role, you will help bring the Sense brand to life across a variety of mediums, from dynamic video edits and motion graphics to striking visual layouts and digital campaigns. If you have a strong eye for aesthetics, a passion for video pacing, and an eagerness to grow your skills in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, we want to meet you. Key Responsibilities Video Editing & Post-Production: Cut, refine, color-grade, and sound-mix a wide range of video content, including social media shorts, brand films, product explainers, and internal communications. Motion Graphics: Design and integrate basic motion graphics, titles, lower-thirds, and transitions to create polished, high-quality deliverables. Platform Optimization: Seamlessly adapt and optimize video assets across multiple formats and aspect ratios (16:9, 9:16, 1:1) for various social and digital platforms. Visual & Digital Design: Support the broader design team by creating digital marketing assets, including presentation decks, social media creatives, landing page visuals, and brochures. Brand Guardianship: Assist in building visual compositions and graphic elements that strictly align with our brand guidelines. Creative Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional teams to unpack creative briefs, pitch strong storytelling concepts, and execute engaging visual solutions. Take Initiative: Proactively contribute creative ideas and bring strong storytelling instincts to every project you touch.

title: Senior/Lead Data Scientist
jobDescription: We care deeply about the success of our customers and strive to help them achieve their goals in inspiring and engaging with their workforce. Sense is seeking a Lead Data Scientist to deliver our contractor communication platform to the world's best places to work. Sense is a rapidly scaling company making this the best environment to take on ownership as well as learning how to grow a company. Sense is building an intelligent recruiting automation platform to help job seekers find the right opportunity. Sense's platform is responsible for interactions with millions of candidates for help gathering their relevant skills, updating their resumes and identifying those jobs for which they are best suited. We're excited to expand the Sense platform with new capabilities to save candidates and recruiters time and streamline the hiring process. We're looking for a hands-on technical lead to lead a team of talented data scientists with an interest in dialog systems, natural language processing, textual analysis, and recommendation systems. Responsibilities • Lead and mentor a group of data scientists to tackle impactful problems such as Recommendation, Search Relevance, Knowledge Graph, etc. Your efforts will critically impact the growth of Sense’s Talent Management Platform. • Analyze datasets with traditional and modern data science techniques • Design new models and algorithms and develop proof-of-concept implementations • Support executive leadership in developing Data Science & NLP strategy • Keep up-to-date on advances in NLP • Leverage deep technical knowledge and work across data science, product and engineering teams working together to accomplish extremely ambitious goals and build a great product.

title: Lead Product Manager
jobDescription: About the Position As the Lead Product Manager – Data & Integrations, you will own and drive Sense’s data platform, integrations ecosystem, and enterprise implementation success. This role is foundational to Sense’s Intelligent Talent Engagement Platform and directly impacts scalability, reliability, and time-to-value for enterprise customers. You will define the product vision and roadmap for data ingestion, data modeling, APIs, ATS/HRIS integrations, and implementation tooling, while also leading and mentoring a team of Technical Program Managers (TPMs) who manage ATS partnerships and complex customer implementations. This is a highly cross-functional leadership role that sits at the intersection of platform strategy, customer delivery, and operational excellence, working closely with Engineering, Architecture, Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, and Go-To-Market teams. Key Responsibilities Product Strategy & Vision Define and own the long-term Data & Integrations Platform vision, aligned with Sense’s broader Intelligent CRM and AI roadmap. Establish a scalable, reliable, and extensible architecture for: ATS & HRIS integrations Data ingestion, normalization, and enrichment APIs, webhooks, and event-driven systems Customer-specific data workflows and configurations Partner with Engineering and Architecture to make strategic trade-offs between flexibility, standardization, and speed. Stay deeply engaged with enterprise customers, ATS partners, and internal stakeholders to anticipate evolving data and integration needs. Roadmap & Prioritization Build and maintain a data platform-first roadmap balancing: New integrations and partner expansions Platform scalability and performance Implementation velocity and operational efficiency Technical debt and reliability improvements Prioritize initiatives based on customer impact, revenue enablement, implementation complexity, and long-term platform health. Clearly communicate roadmap, dependencies, and trade-offs to executive and cross-functional stakeholders. Product Development & Execution Lead the EPD (Engineering–Product–Design) triad for Data & Integrations initiatives. Translate complex, ambiguous problem spaces into clear product requirements, system flows, APIs, and acceptance criteria. Work closely with TPMs and Engineering to unblock execution across multiple concurrent enterprise implementations. Ensure high standards of data quality, observability, security, and compliance across all integrations. Partner with Product Marketing and GTM teams to support launches of new integrations and platform capabilities. Customer, Partner & Stakeholder Engagement Act as the primary product owner for ATS relationships, integration health, and enterprise data workflows. Collaborate with Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, and Implementation teams to reduce time-to-value and improve deployment predictability. Engage directly with strategic customers during discovery, escalations, and roadmap validation. Track and improve key platform metrics such as: Integration stability and uptime Implementation timelines Data accuracy and completeness Customer adoption and satisfaction Work with Product Analytics to derive actionable insights from platform usage and operational data. Team Leadership & People Management Lead, mentor, and manage Technical Program Managers (TPMs) responsible for ATS partnerships and complex customer implementations. Provide clear direction, career growth, and performance feedback to TPMs. Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement across product and delivery teams. Act as a role model for structured thinking, calm execution, and customer-first decision-making. Qualifications Experience 10+ years of overall experience with 7+ years in Product Management within B2B Enterprise Saa S. Strong experience owning platform, data, or integration-heavy products. Proven track record of delivering complex, multi-system products at enterprise scale. Experience working closely with Engineering, Architecture, and Customer-facing teams in agile environments. Prior experience managing or leading TPMs, implementation teams, or platform execution roles is highly desirable. Skills Exceptional system design and platform thinking skills. Strong understanding of: APIs, ETL pipelines, event-driven architectures Enterprise Saa S integrations (ATS, HRIS, CRM ecosystems preferred) Data modeling, reliability, and observability concepts Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, especially in ambiguous and high-stakes scenarios. Ability to balance long-term platform strategy with near-term customer and revenue needs. Proficiency with product and delivery tools such as Jira, Notion, Confluence, and analytics platforms. Education Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. MBA or advanced degree is a plus but not required.

title: Lead Software Engineer II - Backend
jobDescription:
Sense is looking for a Lead Software Engineer
- II to join our Voice Engineering team in Bangalore . This is a senior Individual Contributor (IC) role, where you'll be responsible for designing and building highly scalable, multi-system backend services with strict SLAs. You'll play a crucial role in shaping the technical direction of the team and establishing best engineering practices. Note: This is a full-time, on-site position based out of our Bangalore office . You will be expected to work from the office 4 days a week. Responsibilities System Design & Architecture: Lead the technical design, development, and implementation of scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient backend systems. Engineering Leadership: Drive technical discussions and decision-making within the team. Conduct thorough tech design and code reviews to ensure high-quality, maintainable, and robust code. Engineering Excellence: Establish and promote best practices for software development, including coding standards, testing, and deployment processes. System Optimization: Implement monitoring and observability practices to track system performance and proactively identify bottlenecks. Optimize systems for cost efficiency, scalability, and resilience on AWS. Mentorship: Guide and mentor other engineers on the team, helping them grow their technical skills and understand complex system designs.
